metric.why: The single most quoted efficiency number in the industry. It exposes how much of the electric bill buys computing and how much buys overhead, and it is the number regulators and sustainability reports ask for first.
metric.target: 1.0 is the theoretical floor. Large modern hyperscale facilities report annual fleet averages near 1.1; the industry-wide average has hovered in the mid 1.5s for years.
metric.formula: Total facility energy / IT equipment energy
metric.definition: The ratio of everything a facility draws from the grid to what its IT equipment alone consumes. A PUE of 1.5 means half again as much power goes to cooling, power conversion, and lighting as goes to the servers.
